from collections import Counter
import re

def top_words(text: str, n: int) -> list:
    words = re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', text.lower())
    word_counts = Counter(words)
    return [word for word, count in word_counts.most_common(n) if count == word_counts.most_common(n)[0][1]] + sorted([word for word, count in word_counts.most_common(n) if count < word_counts.most_common(n)[0][1]])
```
